## Install

1. Download **LocalGrammar-*.dmg** below and drag **Local Grammar** into **Applications**.
2. Open Local Grammar. macOS blocks it the first time because it isn't notarized by Apple — go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.
3. Allow **Accessibility** when asked (needed to read and fix the text you're typing).
4. Pick a proofreading engine in the window: **Apple Intelligence** (built in, macOS 26) or **Qwen** (one-time setup).
5. Select text anywhere and press **⌥⌘G**.

Requires an Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 14 or later; Apple Intelligence needs macOS 26. Verify the download with the `.sha256` file: `shasum -a 256 -c LocalGrammar-*.dmg.sha256`
